architecture_research_steps.title: RQGM, koewolucja egzaminatora i typowane AST
Aya eBPF w gościu Firecracker i detekcja syscall
L402, cost exhaustion i disposable apps

items.name: Transport benchmark SHM/TCP
items.scope: Matched real Zenoh SHM and TCP payload corpus
items.acceptance: Raw p50/p95/p99 latency, CPU and memory for 64B, 4KiB, 1MiB messages
items.negative: Reject synthetic clock and unequal hardware

items.name: SHM tenancy and quota
items.scope: Bound shared allocations to UID and tenant capabilities
items.acceptance: 8 publishers stress allocation reclaim, crash and no cross tenant map
items.negative: Reject foreign handle and unbounded pool growth

items.name: Dual CRDT convergence corpus
items.scope: Bridge Automerge JSON with Yrs text using typed adapters
items.acceptance: 10000 randomized concurrent operations converge across restarted replicas
items.negative: Reject stale tombstone revival and schema coercion

items.name: Edge Zenoh interoperability
items.scope: Pin zenoh-pico/no_std compatibility with cloud peers
items.acceptance: Real device or labeled emulator demonstrates suspend reconnect and queued delivery
items.negative: Reject unsupported MCU claimed as measured hardware

items.name: Transport and CRDT release matrix
items.scope: Publish reproducible versioned interoperability cases
items.acceptance: x86_64 and optional arm64 run hash-equal state after network faults
items.negative: Reject incompatible wire frame and malformed CRDT update

items.name: OTel resource precedence
items.scope: Make service name and deployment environment operator configurable
items.acceptance: Real collector records OTEL_SERVICE_NAME and version from process env
items.negative: Reject hard-coded resource override

items.name: Asynchronous span lineage
items.scope: Carry traceparent across Tokio tasks broker and guest boundaries
items.acceptance: 1000 fan-out tasks preserve trace_id and parent span identity
items.negative: Reject orphan span or swapped tenant trace context

items.name: Batch exporter bounded outage
items.scope: Constrain OTel batch queue and collector retry
items.acceptance: 10min collector failure yields bounded RSS, counted dropped spans and live workload
items.negative: Reject unbounded memory or hidden trace loss

items.name: Telemetry orderly shutdown
items.scope: Flush Tracer then Meter then Logger on process exit
items.acceptance: Collector receives final span, metric and log within bounded deadline
items.negative: Reject missing flush receipt and duplicated shutdown

items.name: Telemetry controlled overhead
items.scope: Compare traces at head sampling ratios zero point one and one
items.acceptance: Measured throughput and latency deltas vs matched no telemetry baseline
items.negative: Reject unproven zero cost claim

items.name: CoALA typed memory API
items.scope: Unify four separate memory stores with per tenant capabilities
items.acceptance: Restart and replay an authorized agent decision on identical memory snapshot
items.negative: Reject memory type confusion and foreign tenant read

items.name: UALA decision trace provenance
items.scope: Bind measured uncertainty and Titans gradients to action receipt
items.acceptance: External action logs calibrated uncertainty and selected memory revision
items.negative: Reject NaN gradient and missing confidence

items.name: Titans stability evaluation
items.scope: Bound momentum, gradient, forgetting and checkpoint format
items.acceptance: Seeded replay tracks heldout loss and numerical stability
items.negative: Reject nonfinite update, dimension mismatch and catastrophic regression

items.name: Cognitive cold restore
items.scope: Reconstruct CoALA and optional Titans from authorized checkpoint
items.acceptance: Fresh process reproduces approved memory and provenance graph
items.negative: Reject recovery of revoked personal records

items.name: Cognitive tool safety benchmark
items.scope: Evaluate calibrated UALA gates against actual sandbox actions
items.acceptance: Publish FPR/FNR by risk threshold and baseline
items.negative: Reject high uncertainty destructive action irrespective of reward

items.name: RQGM immutable examiner epoch
items.scope: Pin judge and benchmark corpus digest for whole evaluation epoch
items.acceptance: Independent workers attest one immutable examiner version
items.negative: Reject changed judge during candidate batch

items.name: RQGM score ledger preservation
items.scope: Retain immutable raw evidence and selectively expire superseded scores
items.acceptance: Replay judge transition preserves unrelated source evidence
items.negative: Reject deletion of external judge observations

items.name: Type sitter admission of mutations
items.scope: Parse Rust mutation with pinned tree sitter schema and layer rules
items.acceptance: Real compiled candidate passes dependency DAG and AST gate
items.negative: Reject indirect circular graph and reexport bypass

items.name: Examiner adversarial evaluation
items.scope: Generate protected counterexamples for grading reward hacking
items.acceptance: Heldout mutation corpus reports detection and human baseline
items.negative: Reject contaminated evaluation set and prompt injected candidate

items.name: Mutation deployment rollback
items.scope: Stage accepted candidate behind sandboxed regression and rollback
items.acceptance: Rebuild full regression with signed commit provenance before promotion
items.negative: Reject security regression and self approved risky patch

items.name: SDNN arithmetic property corpus
items.scope: Implement saturating signed spikes and accumulator boundary tests
items.acceptance: 100000 seeded CPU traces yield reproducible exact deltas
items.negative: Reject overflow, zero threshold and invalid channel index

items.name: Loihi optional hardware backend
items.scope: Negotiate SDK capabilities and fallback to CPU when unavailable
items.acceptance: Device inventory records real Loihi chip for hardware comparisons
items.negative: Reject emulator results labeled real hardware

items.name: Energy delay reproducibility
items.scope: Run same model and I/O boundary across available Loihi, Jetson, CPU
items.acceptance: Export measured joules, frame rate and latency with raw repeats
items.negative: Reject document headline ratio as OCAF measurement

items.name: ML KEM provenance and vectors
items.scope: Pin licensed mlkem-native release and supported CPU variants
items.acceptance: Official KAT and negative ciphertext decapsulation run against actual backend
items.negative: Reject changed ciphertext and unsupported accelerator

items.name: Authenticated hybrid PQ handshake
items.scope: Bind classical certificate and ML KEM key to same transport transcript
items.acceptance: Two endpoints complete real handshake and key rotation
items.negative: Reject downgrade replay and identity mismatch

items.name: In guest Aya BPF verifier gate
items.scope: Load actual Aya eBPF ELF into independent Firecracker guest kernel
items.acceptance: Guest BPF ID and verified kernel image digest in KVM evidence
items.negative: Reject host only TC classifier as guest result

items.name: One second syscall window
items.scope: Track guest openat in bounded per PID monotonic windows
items.acceptance: Actual guest syscall event counts correlate with guest PID and tenant
items.negative: Reject PID reuse clock shift and unbounded BPF maps

items.name: Kernel anomaly false positive audit
items.scope: Calibrate entropy and ransomware suffix features with real corpus
items.acceptance: Export FNR and FPR before any process quarantine
items.negative: Reject single suspicious filename as automatic killing proof

items.name: Guest host event correlation
items.scope: Bind guest syscall to host packet via signed VM and workload nonce
items.acceptance: Real guest and host traces match workload and boot ID
items.negative: Reject forged nonce or foreign tenant event

items.name: Guest BPF fail safe controls
items.scope: Lease authorize guest quarantine with revocation and map cleanup
items.acceptance: Probe restart and VM crash preserve deny safety with reversible enforcement
items.negative: Reject missing guest probe falsely reporting security PASS

items.name: L402 settlement provenance
items.scope: Distinguish preimage verification from actual invoice settlement state
items.acceptance: Authorized LN node returns paid invoice reference and amount
items.negative: Reject self declared payment by HMAC alone

items.name: L402 caveat semantics
items.scope: Enforce tenant, scope, time, calls and spend on Macaroon attenuation
items.acceptance: Interoperability test confirms bounded nested caveats across restart
items.negative: Reject unknown caveat and privilege escalation

items.name: Atomic token budget escrow
items.scope: Reserve, commit and refund per tenant tool token budget
items.acceptance: Concurrent 50 agent calls obey caps after simulated leader failover
items.negative: Reject double debit overflow and replayed payment

items.name: Disposable app lifecycle
items.scope: Track application creator, TTL, endpoint and secret revocation
items.acceptance: Real demo app expiry revokes deploy credentials and cleans resources
items.negative: Reject lingering service access after purge

items.name: Energy aware scheduler fallback
items.scope: Use trusted energy budget and opt in for grid aware compute
items.acceptance: Actual meter readings govern optional batch work with offline fallback
items.negative: Reject fabricated energy surplus or implicit paid execution

items.name: Cargo Workspace migration boundary
items.scope: Preserve existing package while staging six functional workspace crates
items.acceptance: Cargo metadata and cargo test workspace complete on main with old API intact
items.negative: Reject cyclic crate graph and removed public CLI

items.name: Six crate typed interfaces
items.scope: Define transport-crdt telemetry-ebpf cognition-rqgm economy-gov domain-swarms master-node boundaries
items.acceptance: Six real crates compile with schema contracts and no unauthorized cycles
items.negative: Reject direct dependency on privileged runtime from untrusted plugin

items.name: Core domain swarms integration
items.scope: Bind OmniDev OmniUX OmniE2E OmniForge OmniWeb OmniMath and OmniSec to capability registry
items.acceptance: Seven swarms execute real authorized fixture tasks with trace and audit
items.negative: Reject fabricated tool completion and missing sandbox

items.name: Extended domain adapters
items.scope: Integrate OmniNous OmniHoncho OmniZeroClick OmniDiT OmniLex and OmniHFT as opt in adapters
items.acceptance: Real backend smoke or explicit DISABLED gate for all six systems
items.negative: Reject absent credentials reported as live deployment

items.name: Sovereign master integrated workflow
items.scope: Compose broker Firecracker PostgreSQL CRDT telemetry cognition action gates and swarms
items.acceptance: One authorized request has verified identity trace durable result and recovery
items.negative: Reject network partition stale epoch or missing evidence as success

items.name: WASI guest provenance
items.scope: Bind live WASIp1 execution receipt to broker lease and kernel identity
items.acceptance: Two real guest nonces show distinct Wasmtime child exit and hashes
items.negative: Reject host side WASI pretending to be guest execution

items.name: In guest eBPF loading
items.scope: Build and actually insert Aya syscall probe inside Firecracker kernel
items.acceptance: Authenticated guest BPF program ID and openat events collected
items.negative: Reject host Aya proof as guest program ID

items.name: Guest process quarantine
items.scope: Enforce authorized PID isolation after corroborated syscall anomaly
items.acceptance: Guest child is stopped while second tenant VM remains alive
items.negative: Reject entropy only irreversible SIGKILL

items.name: VM trace propagation
items.scope: Carry broker traceparent through Firecracker boot and guest receipt
items.acceptance: Collector correlates two independent VM traces under correct tenant
items.negative: Reject reused cross tenant serial receipt

items.name: Live WAL vs artifact recovery distinction
items.scope: Require direct two kernel TCP stream to count as distributed HA
items.acceptance: Two separate Linux boot IDs continuously exchange actual PostgreSQL WAL
items.negative: Reject artifact mediated cold restore counted as TCP streaming

items.name: Postgres quorum witness
items.scope: Require third witness fencing token before standby promotion
items.acceptance: Network partition and old primary return never yield two writable nodes
items.negative: Reject expired epoch or dual primary overlap

items.name: Distributed escrow durability
items.scope: Persist authorized billing and job reservations on fenced transactional HA store
items.acceptance: Failover preserves committed ledger and refuses duplicate settlements
items.negative: Reject stale leader ledger modifications

items.name: WAL failover trace continuity
items.scope: Correlate LSN lag and timeline across old and new leader
items.acceptance: Real promotion trace shows exact WAL catchup and reconnect
items.negative: Reject partial trace claiming RPO zero

items.name: Eight step method inventory
items.scope: Document per step owner test threat model and source-page traceability
items.acceptance: Automation detects missing step for all eight research phases
items.negative: Reject synthetic empirical PDF benchmarks as CI evidence

items.name: Integrated 60 minute soak
items.scope: Stress live broker VM PG WAL and swarms concurrently for at least 60min
items.acceptance: Measured duration and p95 memory LSN exits and errors archived
items.negative: Reject 30s smoke called one hour test

items.name: Memory and trace chaos
items.scope: Fault inject CRDT divergence delayed trace export and Titans restore
items.acceptance: No cross tenant leak unbounded queue or revoked snapshot recovery
items.negative: Reject memory accuracy score as chaos validation

items.name: Settlement disaster reconciliation
items.scope: Test escrow failover L402 expiry and delayed authorization responses
items.acceptance: Post restore ledger matches genuine events without double charge
items.negative: Reject fake settlement and spending after revoke

items.name: Cargo backwards compatibility
items.scope: Stage Rust workspace crates without rewriting existing root runtime binary
items.acceptance: All existing cargo tests and CLI entrypoints pass on main
items.negative: Reject breaking API without migration and tests

items.name: Workspace licensing and SBOM
items.scope: Record actual upstream license resolved hash and dependency vulnerabilities
items.acceptance: Pinned SBOM cargo deny and audit cover all crates
items.negative: Reject unlicensed code or unpinned binary

items.name: Release evidence scope matrix
items.scope: Separate real host, guest, Loihi, LN and test lab proof per feature
items.acceptance: Production gate demands real evidence IDs and scopes
items.negative: Reject prototype PDF code counted as production PASS

items.name: Reproducible rollback
items.scope: Sign manifests and test rollback of workspace update on fresh runner
items.acceptance: Artifact SHA and prior version behavior recover after rollback
items.negative: Reject revoked secrets or unsigned image restored
